body: Context: owner approved committing the fake, already-public fixture with ALLOW_SECRET_COMMIT=1, but lore's pre-commit leak rule url_with_password also blocks it. Chosen: --no-verify for that single file, after gitleaks and lore check leaks showed only that one known finding. Alternatives: reword the fixture (breaks the promise that dotenv tests move unchanged) or leave it untracked. Reason: keeps the test-unchanged promise; the value is fake and public; scope limited to one commit (owner standing order 2026-11-12: decide inside the build).
title: Commit dotenv/example_plugin_test.go past lore's leak hook with --no-verify
